-- Schema for database: rschema_0217

CREATE TABLE `course` (
  `course_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `teacher` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `class_hours` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `description` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `schedule` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`course_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `student` (
  `student_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `grade` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `class` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `user_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`student_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `student_ibfk_user_id` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `user` (`user_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `user` (
  `user_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `password` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `username` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `role` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`user_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `tool` (
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `asset_number` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `holder` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`asset_number`),
  CONSTRAINT `tool_ibfk_holder` FOREIGN KEY (`holder`) REFERENCES `user` (`user_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `tool_loan_record` (
  `record_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `borrower` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `asset_number` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `time` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`record_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `tool_loan_record_ibfk_borrower` FOREIGN KEY (`borrower`) REFERENCES `user` (`user_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `tool_loan_record_ibfk_asset_number` FOREIGN KEY (`asset_number`) REFERENCES `tool` (`asset_number`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `system_settings` (
  `setting_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `system_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `theme` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `page_configuration` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `version_information` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`setting_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `course_enrollment` (
  `student_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `course_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`student_id`, `course_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `course_enrollment_ibfk_student_id` FOREIGN KEY (`student_id`) REFERENCES `student` (`student_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `course_enrollment_ibfk_course_id` FOREIGN KEY (`course_id`) REFERENCES `course` (`course_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
gold_question: Business Requirements Description for the Educational Management System: A school plans to develop an educational management system aimed at integrating course management, student management, user management, system settings, and tool asset management. The course management module shall record Course ID, teacher, class hours, description, and schedule to support course inquiries and arrangements. The student management module shall record Student ID, name, grade, and class, facilitating the management and communication of student information. The course enrollment module shall record Student ID and Course ID for managing course selections by students. The user management module is responsible for maintaining User ID, email, password, and username, ensuring system security. The system settings module shall store system name, theme, page configuration, and version information for system configuration adjustments. The tool management module shall record the name, asset number, and holder, and manage tool loan records, including Record ID, borrower, asset number, and time, to optimize asset management.
nl_text:
This schema is for a school management system, which includes information about courses, students, teachers, tools, and system settings. The database name is rschema_0217.
The course table contains information about the courses offered at the school, including the course ID, teacher, class hours, description, and schedule. The primary key is the course ID.
The student table contains information about the students enrolled in the courses, including the student ID, name, grade, class, and user ID. The primary key is the student ID, and there is a foreign key constraint on the user ID, which references the user table.
The user table contains information about the users of the system, including the user ID, email, password, username, and role. The primary key is the user ID.
The tool table contains information about the tools used in the school, including the name, asset number, and holder. The primary key is the asset number, and there is a foreign key constraint on the holder, which references the user table.
The tool loan record table contains information about the loans of tools by students, including the record ID, borrower, asset number, and time. The primary key is the record ID, and there are foreign key constraints on the borrower and asset number, which reference the user and tool tables, respectively.
The system settings table contains information about the system, including the system name, theme, page configuration, and version information. The primary key is the setting ID.
The course enrollment table contains information about the enrollment of students in courses, including the student ID and course ID. The primary key is the combination of student ID and course ID, and there are foreign key constraints on the student ID and course ID, which reference the student and course tables, respectively.
